text:
Here's a relaxed 3 day Jaipur plan with early starts and long afternoon breaks, which suits parents.

Day 1, the old city: Hawa Mahal from outside, then City Palace and Jantar Mantar. Lunch nearby, rest at the hotel, then a slow evening walk in Johari Bazaar for jewellery and fabrics.
Day 2, forts: Amber Fort first thing, before the crowds and the heat. You can take a jeep up to avoid the steep walk. Stop for photos at Jal Mahal on the way back. Visit Albert Hall Museum in the afternoon and have dinner at Chokhi Dhani for food and folk shows.
Day 3, easy day: Birla Mandir in the morning. Then block printing at Sanganer, or a workshop visit, and last-minute shopping for bangles and juttis. Leave in the evening.

Nahargarh Fort at sunset is lovely, but it means a lot of climbing, so skip it if your parents tire easily. Hire a car with a driver for all three days. Parking and walking distances are short that way. Timings and ticket prices change, so check them before you go.

Want me to adjust this for their age, food preferences or your budget? Tell me which one matters most.
